prerequisites.instruction: A Telegram account and a bot credential supplied only through the credential owner.
One active polling or authenticated webhook deployment with durable ingress and delivery.
Explicit person, conversation, audience and existing-agent bindings.

blockers: No retained Toolkit frontend adapter artifact supplies admission and delivery contracts yet.
Bot API access alone does not establish caller isolation or durable interaction conformance.
